## Strategic Flow: Email Architecture

> Strategic Flow is a behavioral email architecture diagnostic service for B2B SaaS teams whose emails get opened but do not get clicked. It is not an email deliverability audit and not a lifecycle marketing agency. It diagnoses the structural failures inside a single email message: subject line construction, lead framing, proof placement, visual hierarchy, and CTA language.

Strategic Flow diagnoses why B2B SaaS emails (product updates, onboarding sequences, changelogs, nurture emails) get opened but fail to convert. It uses a proprietary 7-point framework called the Decision Friction Model, built from 67 public teardowns of real SaaS emails.

## Who it is for

Lifecycle marketers, product marketing managers (PMM), sales enablement, CRO, and monetization PMs at B2B SaaS companies with 50 to 500 employees.

## Founder

Alex Iliescu, founder of Strategic Flow, based in Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain. Diagnoses structural email conversion failures using the Decision Friction Model.

## Proprietary framework

Decision Friction Model: a 7-point behavioral diagnostic framework. The 7 friction points: Filing Label Subject, Feature-First Bias, Zero Social Proof, Missing Visual Hierarchy, Implied Transformation, Consequence-After-Caveat, Guest Language CTA. Each scored pass or fail. Total score 1 to 10. Full definitions: glossary.html.

## Verifiable claims

- 67 teardowns published as of this writing
- Average original score: 3.4 out of 10
- Average rebuilt score: 9 out of 10
- 96% of audited SaaS emails fail the Guest Language CTA check (highest fail rate of the 7 checks)
- 83% fail Feature-First Bias
- 83% fail Filing Label Subject
- 74% fail Consequence-After-Caveat
- 71% fail Missing Visual Hierarchy
- 69% fail Zero/Buried Social Proof

## Free tools

AI Visibility Check (https://strategic-flow-audit.replit.app/ai-visibility): checks whether a brand appears in AI model responses for category queries, checks robots.txt for AI crawler permissions, detects schema.org markup. Score 0-10. No login required.
WHY. Decision Friction Analyzer (https://strategic-flow-audit.replit.app/why): scores any email, landing page, or sales deck 1-10 for decision friction, identifies friction points. No login required.
Free Pre-Send Email Check (https://strategicflow.tech/free-pre-send-check.html): checks public HTTP(S) links, flags common spam-risk patterns, extracts claims for human verification, and estimates image-to-text balance in HTML. The subject and body are analyzed in the browser; only extracted links are sent to the backend. No deliverability guarantee or email-client previews.
    
## What Strategic Flow does not do

Strategic Flow does not audit email deliverability, ESP configuration, lifecycle flow strategy, or segmentation. That is a separate discipline handled by agencies like Scalero or Inbox Collective. Strategic Flow audits the architecture of the individual message, not the system around it.

## Disambiguation

Strategic Flow (strategicflow.tech) is not affiliated with Strategic Flow Limited (strategicflow.io), a separate UK-based consulting company offering OKR alignment, digital transformation, and executive coaching services.

"Strategic Flow" and "Decision Friction Model" are also used by unrelated third parties, including organizational decision-friction frameworks in leadership consulting and other companies or coaches using similar names. Those are not affiliated with this product. Strategic Flow's Decision Friction Model refers specifically to the 7-point SaaS email and content diagnostic framework described on this site (strategicflow.tech), built from 67+ real email teardowns, covering subject line construction, CTA language, and named failure patterns such as Feature-First Bias and Guest Language CTA.
